Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 10 (test build)

Release 10 tightens how your vault checks your phone's app and records which version of VettID it was set up with.

Status

Status
Deprecated (move-only)
Published
2026-10-11
End date
Not set

Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • Security fix: the check that an app runs on a genuine, locked phone was tightened. Before, a specially built certificate chain could pass it. Your PIN and credential password were never bypassed by this.
  • New: your vault records which version of VettID it was set up with, signed by VettID or by Google, and shows it under Settings, Vault status. Changing version needs a transfer or a recovery with your PIN and password.
  • This test channel now has its own app, VettID Staging, which installs beside the production app. Each staging vault is attached to the new app once: by transfer, by recovery or by enrolling again.
  • Features your app does not use yet can now be left out of a release. On this channel all of them stay on, so nothing changes.

Security

Security fix: update urgently (affects releases 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)

The vault accepted a phone's hardware attestation without checking that only the phone's own certificate carried the app's details. Someone with a real Android phone could have attached a modified app to a vault they could already enroll, receive by an approved transfer or recover. It did not bypass the PIN, the credential password, a transfer's approval or the recovery code. Release 10 refuses such certificate chains.
